messages:
Priya L.: Quick announce: published the 'Private Telemetry Consent Flow' KB entry for on-prem and VPC installs. This standardizes how customers present telemetry consent during onboarding and how operators can toggle consent post-install. KB: https://internal.kb/redwood/onprem-telemetry-consent

Rowan (eng): TL;DR: new agent flag `telemetry.consent_mode` with options `prompt`, `preconsent`, `disabled`. When `prompt` the operator UI will surface a consent banner during first-run and the agent will delay non-essential telemetry until consent is recorded.

Iris (prod): Added a short customer-facing checklist in the KB: 'what customers will see' + examples for managed vs self-hosted installs. Important note: consent changes are recorded in the cluster audit log and cannot be retroactively applied to already-uploaded payloads.

Carlos (customer-success): Can we get a one-paragraph blurb for sales to use in discovery calls? Need something clear for regulated prospects.

Maya (legal): Reviewed. Need to make two clarifications before publishing externally: (1) explicit retention window for de-identified telemetry when consent is withheld, (2) wording for EU customers re: lawful basis. I added suggested language in the KB draft.

ops-bot: KB draft posted: /kb/onprem-telemetry-consent-2026-03-24  reviewers requested: eng, legal, customer-success, security

Priya L.: Implementation notes snippet (in KB):

```yaml
# values.yaml example
telemetry:
  consent_mode: prompt  # options: prompt | preconsent | disabled
  retention_days: 30
```

Rowan (eng): Agent change: exposes `/telemetry/consent` API and writes `telemetry.consent=true|false` to host-metadata. Sample curl for operators in KB. No forced upgrade; clusters running agent-v3+ will support prompt flow.

```
# sample curl to set consent
curl -X POST https://agent.local/telemetry/consent -d '{"consent":true}' -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"
```

Carlos (customer-success): Scheduling two customer briefings (Tue 5pm PT, Fri 10am PT) to walk pilot customers through the flow and gather feedback. Will post invites in #customer-success.

Maya (legal): Action items: @Rowan update KB with the EU lawful-basis paragraph by Mon EOD; @Priya coordinate CS briefings; @Iris verify the retention defaults and update the privacy appendix. React with :white_check_mark: when done.

Priya L.: Thanks team. Goal: ship note to sales and support by next Wednesday after legal signoff. React with :thumbsup: if you can attend the briefings.
